common: Edit this Korean RuneNexus UI mockup to include an explicit still-unopened slot purchase/expansion option, as requested by user. Keep original game metal/teal theme, socket and gem artwork, compact typography and useful information hierarchy. Same incoming range gem and three existing gems. Scenario now is link-expansion research COMPLETED: 3 currently open sockets are full, maximum available capacity 4. Replace misleading '슬롯 3/3' with '장착 3개 · 최대 4개'. Price from actual domain is 180 G, owned gold example 3000 G, purchase leaves 2820 G. Never invent extra capacity or free expansion. Keep only the existing THREE circular sockets displayed, do not add a fourth locked/empty socket or padlock icon. Instead add one compact metallic selectable plate BELOW the three sockets, with clear + icon and exact text '새 슬롯 추가 · 180 G'; a small radio circle distinguishes selection from an immediate purchase. Nearby text '보유 3000 G' and '기존 젬 유지 · 새 슬롯에 장착'. This plate is a preview choice, same as choosing an existing gem; ONE primary confirm does the actual action. Two choices coexist: select existing red gem to replace (return old to storage), OR select slot addition to keep all existing gems and add the blue range gem. Do not add a second direct purchase confirm button. Fit whole modal without clipping, reduce redundant padding/oversize decorative text if necessary. Separate compact × and secondary '포탑 다시 선택' remain. Fix any misleading underlined '보관함으로 반환' to plain non-clickable text. All text crisp Korean.
